title: Cross-vantage transfer of endpoint intrinsic ACCESS-BARRIER persistence and the anchor-built intrinsic-denylist validity horizon (V1 datacenter egress vs V2 pinned independent Tor egress, same frozen 57-endpoint pool, same window ladder)
question: Per director_mandate (action REOPEN, target C-WEB-DYNAMICS): does the measured endpoint intrinsic access-barrier persistence and its anchor-built intrinsic-denylist validity horizon - right-censored at 1800 s on one egress and one ~2041 s session (accepted S1_STATIONARY, EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597, audit PASS, declared single-vantage boundary VF5) - transfer across independent source vantages, or is the S1_STATIONARY result an artifact of that single network vantage and window? Concretely: over the same window ladder (nominal 0/300/900/1800 s) at a SECOND independent egress (distinct public IP / ASN / geography; realized here as a pinned Tor exit, provisioned and verified pre-freeze) using the same frozen 57-endpoint pool and frozen intrinsic classifier, (Q1) do the same endpoints retain their intrinsic class (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE / TRANSPORT_ERROR) at the second vantage with per-class CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.80, (Q2) does an anchor-built intrinsic denylist at the second vantage remain valid through delta_ref (FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20 and FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20, with the within-vantage B_EXCHANGE null rejected and a positive endpoint-clustered CI lower bound), and (Q3) do the per-endpoint intrinsic classes agree across vantages so that ONE shared denylist is licensed rather than a vantage-specific schedule? The experiment runs a PAIRED two-vantage session: the same session, same pool, same ladder, same classifier is observed simultaneously from V1 (the runner's direct datacenter egress, AS8075 Microsoft) and V2 (the pinned independent Tor egress, distinct ASN/geography). It does NOT repeat the single-vantage ladder. If no second independent egress substrate can be provisioned and held constant (pin verification failure, exit rotation, route loss), the exact operational blocker is recorded as MEASUREMENT_INVALID instead of substituting another single-vantage run.

hypothesis.H1_vantage_robust: The intrinsic barrier state and its anchor denylist transfer across vantages: at V2 the intrinsic classes present at the V2 anchor persist to the V2 reference rung (per-class CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.80), the V2 anchor-built intrinsic denylist is valid at delta_ref (FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20 and FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20), the V2 anchor->lag barrier indicator carries information beyond the exchangeable constant null within V2 (V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL >= 0.05 nats, B_EXCHANGE_V2 permutation p < 0.05, clustered CI lower > 0), the V1-anchor and V2-anchor barrier indicators agree beyond the cross-vantage exchangeable null (CV_SKILL >= 0.05 nats, B_CROSSVANTAGE permutation p < 0.05, clustered CI lower > 0), and the V1-anchor denylist transfers to V2 at delta_ref (CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20 and CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20). Product consequence: ONE shared intrinsic denylist (one class-conditional barrier policy) is licensed across the two tested egresses on this pool/window.
hypothesis.H0_vantage_specific: The intrinsic barrier state or its denylist does NOT transfer: on the valid paired run, at least one of the five T1 clauses fails (V2 per-class persistence < 0.80 for a present intrinsic class; V2 denylist invalid; V2 anchor->lag information not above the exchangeable null; cross-vantage anchor agreement not above the cross-vantage null; or cross-vantage denylist transfer invalid). Product consequence: the intrinsic barrier access decision is vantage-specific on this pool/window (within the tested datacenter <-> Tor egress pair); a single shared denylist is falsified as a universal prior and a per-egress (per-egress-type) schedule is required.
hypothesis.H_null: B_CROSSVANTAGE: the V2 anchor barrier indicator is independent of the V1 anchor barrier indicator beyond its marginal (exchangeable endpoints), so CV_SKILL ~ 0 and a denylist built at V1 is no better than the no-denylist constant prior at V2. B_EXCHANGE_V2: within V2, the lag barrier indicator is independent of the V2 anchor indicator beyond its marginal. Both nulls are calibrated before freeze with demonstrated power (see PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY and NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE) and a false-positive bound, exactly as the parent's B_EXCHANGE was.
hypothesis.relation_to_claim: H1/H0/H_null are orthogonal falsifiable programs on the C-WEB-DYNAMICS next_gate axis 'barriers' (source-vantage factor), i.e. the declarative single-vantage boundary VF5 of the accepted S1_STATIONARY packet. No branch here upgrades C-WEB-DYNAMICS above HYPOTHESIS and no PRODUCT_CORE promotion follows from this single egress-pair/window ladder.

falsifier: TWO-SIDED AND FROZEN; both directions are reachable through the frozen metrics and branch logic (verified by the pre-freeze offline calibration on synthetic worlds implementing the EXACT branch rule; see prereg.md 'Null calibration and branch reachability'). Frozen thresholds: delta_ref_s = 1800; delta_ref_min_actual_s = 1500 (per vantage); intrinsic_persistence_min = 0.80; tau_FA = tau_FR = 0.20; alpha = 0.05; delta_SKILL_nats = 0.05; pc_power_min = 0.80; nc_false_positive_max = 0.05; min_t0_intrinsic = 3 and min_t0_barrier = 3 per vantage; bootstrap_resamples = 10000; permutations = 10000. Definitions: V2_CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c] = fraction of endpoints whose V2 ambient class at the V2 anchor equals intrinsic class c and whose V2 ambient class at the V2 delta_ref rung is also c. V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT = (n_t0_intrinsic_V2 >= 3) AND (for every intrinsic class c present at the V2 anchor: V2_CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c] >= 0.80). V2_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT = |{V2 anchor intrinsic, non-intrinsic at V2 delta_ref}| / |V2 anchor intrinsic|; V2_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT = |{V2 anchor non-intrinsic, intrinsic at V2 delta_ref}| / |V2 anchor non-intrinsic|; V2_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID = (FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20) AND (FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20). V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL = plug-in mutual information I(B_V2_T0; B_V2_delta_ref) in nats over the binary barrier indicator (B = 1 iff ambient class in barrier_set). V2_STAT_SIG = (V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL >= 0.05) AND (B_EXCHANGE_V2 permutation p < 0.05) AND (endpoint-clustered bootstrap CI lower > 0). CV_SKILL = plug-in I(B_V1_T0; B_V2_T0) in nats. CV_AGREEMENT_SIG = (CV_SKILL >= 0.05) AND (B_CROSSVANTAGE permutation p < 0.05) AND (endpoint-clustered bootstrap CI lower > 0). CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT = |{V1 anchor intrinsic, non-intrinsic at V2 delta_ref}| / |V1 anchor intrinsic|; CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT = |{V1 anchor non-intrinsic, intrinsic at V2 delta_ref}| / |V1 anchor non-intrinsic|; CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID = (FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20) AND (FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20). T1_VANTAGE_ROBUST iff V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND V2_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID AND V2_STAT_SIG AND CV_AGREEMENT_SIG AND CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID. T0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC iff the measurement is valid and NOT T1_VANTAGE_ROBUST; the frozen T0 evidence classes are (a) v2_intrinsic_break (a durable intrinsic barrier at V2 changed class), (b) v2_denylist_violation (a V2-denylisted endpoint recovered, or a V2-clean endpoint newly and durably blocked), (c) v2_no_anchor_information (V2 anchor->lag barrier information is no better than the within-V2 exchangeable constant null), (d) no_cross_vantage_information (V1 vs V2 anchor barrier agreement is no better than the cross-vantage exchangeable null), (e) cross_vantage_transfer_violation (the V1-anchor denylist does not transfer to V2 at delta_ref: FALSE_ACCEPT > 0.20 or FALSE_REJECT > 0.20). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved exclusively for prerequisite/control/substrate failure (including egress pinning or constancy failure and any route-health failure) and MUST NOT be used for a scientific T0. Pre-freeze synthetic calibration (script sha256 7b35e2e0e0e78fb638269127b0053a5bfe06a52abadaec64472982e194ae14db, output sha256 fbaabfeac1f4e9c612f9b4e34b9190ad63e75d01f2f2fa000b627370bce5a6bc): PC planted rho=0.98 -> T1 in 245/300 (0.8167 >= 0.80; CV permutation-significant in 300/300); PC rho=0.92 -> T1 in 0.73; NC exchangeable -> T1 in 0/300 with CV permutation-significant fraction 0.04 (<= 0.05); NEG vantage-superset (>= 11 of the 50 V1-clean endpoints blocked at V2) -> T1 in 0/300 (T0 via cross_vantage_transfer_violation); NEG independent-but-stationary vantages -> T1 in 0/300 (T0 via no_cross_vantage_information).

B_EXCHANGE_V2.description: Within-vantage memory/constant null at the SECOND vantage: a GLOBAL uniform permutation of the V2 lag barrier indicator B_V2_delta_ref across all 57 endpoints (10000 permutations, seed 38121193195), preserving both marginals, recomputing I(B_V2_T0; B_V2_delta_ref) each time. This is the same statistic family as the parent's accepted B_EXCHANGE, applied to V2 data; it asserts the V2 anchor state carries no information about the V2 lag state beyond its marginal.
B_EXCHANGE_V2.role: primary strong null for V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL (mandate Q2)

B_CROSSVANTAGE.description: Cross-vantage exchangeable null (mandate Q3): a GLOBAL uniform permutation of the V2 anchor barrier indicator B_V2_T0 across all 57 endpoints (10000 permutations, seed 38121193195), preserving both marginals, recomputing I(B_V1_T0; B_V2_T0) each time. This is the null that the V1 anchor state carries no information about the V2 anchor state beyond its marginal (exchangeable endpoints). It is exactly the WP-002B guard realized: class agreement across vantages is measured with endpoint-clustered uncertainty and a permutation null, never assumed.
B_CROSSVANTAGE.role: primary strong null for CV_SKILL (mandate Q3)

B_CONSTANT_USABLE.description: No-denylist floor (predict non-intrinsic for every endpoint at every rung at V2). Reference for the secondary V2_DENYLIST_SKILL log-loss improvement.

B_MARGINAL_V2.description: Predict the V2 lag intrinsic class from the V2 lag-period marginal class frequency (constant-marginal null).

B_LASTSWEEP_V2.description: Predict the next V2 rung's barrier indicator from the immediately preceding V2 rung rather than from the V2 anchor (re-probe interval diagnostic at V2).

baselines.comparison: V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL is tested against B_EXCHANGE_V2; CV_SKILL is tested against B_CROSSVANTAGE; the denylist decisions are compared with B_CONSTANT_USABLE via V2_DENYLIST_SKILL. B_MARGINAL_V2 and B_LASTSWEEP_V2 are reported diagnostics only.

PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.description: Offline planted robust-transfer generator on the parent pilot marginal (46 CLEAN, 5 BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, 1 TRANSPORT_ERROR, 5 OTHER_NONBARRIER; the same marginal used for the parent's PC): the V2 anchor classes equal the V1 anchor classes (perfect cross-vantage agreement at the anchor) and the V2 lag class equals the V1 anchor class with probability rho, else is redrawn from the marginal. The EXACT frozen branch rule (V2 persistence + V2 denylist + V2_STAT_SIG + CV_AGREEMENT_SIG + CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID, with within-vantage and cross-vantage permutation tests and endpoint-clustered bootstrap CI clauses) is applied to every replication.
PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.power_requirement: Fraction of replications selecting T1_VANTAGE_ROBUST must be >= 0.80 at rho=0.98, and is reported at rho=0.92.
PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.construct_boundary: Validates that the estimator and the five-part branch logic recover a known jointly-stationary two-vantage endpoint population at n=57; it does not assert that any real endpoint is robust across vantages.

PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.description: Live positive control on non-pool hosts with deterministic status, executed on BOTH vantages (V1 direct opener and V2 pinned-tunnel opener): https://httpbin.org/status/429 and redundant https://httpbingo.org/status/429 must classify RATE_LIMIT_429; https://no-such-host.invalid/ must classify TRANSPORT_ERROR (through the V2 tunnel the expected error is 'Tunnel connection failed: 503 Service Unavailable (resolve failed)' which still yields status None -> TRANSPORT_ERROR); https://httpbin.org/status/403 must classify UNAVAILABLE_403 (proving 403-as-plain is not read as a challenge block on either egress).
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.pass_condition: Every oracle request on every vantage classified into its expected class; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.construct_boundary: Confirms the live collection+classifier path registers barriers identically through both egresses and separates 403-as-block from 403-as-plain; not a natural Web barrier.

NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.description: Offline exchangeable generator: V1 anchor, V2 anchor and V2 lag states drawn independently from the same marginal (equal to the observed V1 anchor marginal); the EXACT frozen branch rule is applied.
NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.pass_condition: Fraction of R replications with B_CROSSVANTAGE permutation p < 0.05 must be <= 0.05 (and T1 fraction must be 0).
NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.construct_boundary: A genuinely exchangeable two-vantage endpoint population must not yield spurious cross-vantage skill.

NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.description: Live negative control on https://httpbin.org/status/200, https://httpbin.org/uuid and https://example.com/, which must classify CLEAN on BOTH vantages.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.pass_condition: All requests classify CLEAN on both vantages; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.construct_boundary: Confirms the classifier does not fire on clean responses through either egress.

C_VANTAGE_EVIDENCE.description: Validity control for the second-egress construct, NOT a statistical null: at the anchor, record V2 identity via https://api.ipify.org (IP), https://ifconfig.co/json (IP, ASN, asn_org, country, country_iso, hostname), https://ipwho.is/ (redundant ASN/geo), https://check.torproject.org/api/ip (IsTor must be true) and V1 identity via http://ip-api.com/json (IP, ASN, country) and https://api.ipify.org (IP); at every rung, record the V2 exit IP via the tunnel (must equal the pinned rung-0 exit IP), the V2 route-health oracle https://httpbin.org/status/200 via the tunnel (must classify CLEAN), the V1 IP via direct ipify, and the V1 ASN via direct ip-api (must stay constant). ipinfo.io and ip-api.com are known to be blocked through the Tor tunnel (pre-freeze probe) and are NOT used for V2 identity.

literal_design_values.pinned_exit_requirement: V2 exit IP identical across all four rungs and equal to the pre-flight pinned IP
literal_design_values.distinctness_requirement: V2 exit IP != V1 IP; V2 ASN != V1 ASN; V2 country != V1 country
literal_design_values.v1_constancy_requirement: V1 ASN identical across all four rungs
literal_design_values.route_health_requirement: V2 httpbin/status/200 oracle classifies CLEAN before every rung sweep

C_VANTAGE_EVIDENCE.pass_condition: All four requirements hold for all rungs; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact egress series recorded.
C_VANTAGE_EVIDENCE.construct_boundary: Certifies the 'one second independent egress' construct (distinct IP/ASN/geo, held constant); it is a substrate-integrity gate, not a scientific claim.

C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.description: Validity control for protocol self-induction at each vantage, NOT a statistical null: ambient barrier prevalence across the ladder rungs per vantage on the 52 non-stress endpoints (the parent's stratum), plus a two-sided trend whose clustered CI excludes 0, reported as a disclosure (mirrors the parent's C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION).
C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.pass_condition: No hard pass/fail; reported transparently in result.json.
C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.construct_boundary: Detects whether the repeated two-vantage probing protocol itself changes ambient barrier prevalence at either vantage.

measurement_validity.target_integrity: Every request stores raw HTTP status, response headers (server, cf-mitigated, retry-after), body SHA-256, body byte length, elapsed ms, transport error string, transport error class, and a printable 8192-char body prefix; plus vantage tag (V1/V2) and rung. Classification is a pure deterministic function of those stored fields, so AUDIT can recompute the class exactly on either vantage.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: The anchor T0 and all rungs are independent observations of the SAME endpoints; there is no train/test split. All primary metrics are closed-form functions of per-endpoint class sequences per vantage. Sampling order within a rung is a frozen seeded permutation (seed 38121193195) and does not depend on outcomes.
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: The 57-endpoint universe is frozen and may not be substituted, added to, or dropped. Per-rung probe order is the frozen seeded permutation. No endpoint may be dropped after seeing its outcomes. The V2-then-V1 per-endpoint pairing order is fixed and does not depend on outcomes.
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Endpoint-permutation nulls: 10000 GLOBAL uniform shuffles of the lag (or V2-anchor) barrier indicator across all 57 endpoints (seed 38121193195) for both B_EXCHANGE_V2 and B_CROSSVANTAGE. Endpoint-clustered bootstrap: cluster = registrable_domain (URL host with one leading 'www.' stripped and the final two dot-separated labels retained; no multi-label public suffix occurs in the frozen 57); 10000 resamples (seed 38121193195), percentile 95% CIs, for both V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL and CV_SKILL.
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: One stdlib-HTTP client implementation (Python 3.12 standard library ONLY; numpy NOT required or imported) realized as two openers: V1 = direct default route, V2 = same client routed through the pinned Tor HTTPTunnelPort CONNECT proxy (urllib ProxyHandler), which is byte-transparent for TLS so origin responses are preserved; one continuous session. The frozen classifier and all constants are literal in this spec. Results describe this frozen pool, this datacenter <-> Tor egress pair and this window ladder only.
measurement_validity.control_integrity: PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY T1-power (permutation significance under planted robust transfer) must be >= 0.80; NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE cross-vantage false-positive must be <= 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE live classifications must be correct on BOTH vantages. Any failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a scientific negative.
measurement_validity.prerequisite_integrity: Both vantages must reach the frozen universe and both oracle host groups. On EACH vantage, at T0, >= 3 ambient intrinsic endpoints and >= 3 ambient barrier endpoints; anchor sweep and delta_ref=1800 s rung complete with actual delta >= 1500 s. Egress gates (C_VANTAGE_EVIDENCE): V2 exit pinned and identical across rungs, distinct IP/ASN/geo from V1, IsTor true at anchor; V1 ASN constant across rungs. V2 route-health oracle classes CLEAN before every rung. Any shortfall => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (attainability/substrate failure, recorded as the exact blocker receipt the mandate allows).
measurement_validity.power_integrity: Detection power at the observed V2 anchor intrinsic counts is REPORTED (POWER_AT_RHO98, POWER_AT_RHO92 with the frozen calibration); it is not a gate. No branch depends on non-significance being read as falsification: T0 requires at least one of the five enumerated positive change classes.
measurement_validity.egress_integrity: The second egress is provisioned as a purpose-built anonymous-network exit via a tor 0.4.x instance started by EXECUTE with SocksPort 0, HTTPTunnelPort 127.0.0.1:19051, ControlPort + CookieAuthentication for SETCONF, MaxCircuitDirtiness 7200, NewCircuitPeriod 7200. Pre-flight: discover the unpinned exit IP via https://api.ipify.org through the tunnel; pin it with SETCONF ExitNodes=<ip> StrictNodes=1; SIGNAL NEWNYM; verify api.ipify.org through the tunnel returns the pinned IP (up to 3 attempts). Pinning to the exact IP literal (not a /24) was verified pre-freeze to hold a constant exit IP across repeated checks while /24 pinning rotated within the subnet; exit rotation otherwise occurs within minutes on an unpinned instance (pre-freeze observation). If pin verification fails, EXECUTE records the exact error series and terminates as MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate blocker).
measurement_validity.timing_integrity: Session start S is defined after pre-flight (egress pin verified, oracle battery passed). Each rung k starts at nominal offset LADDERS[k] from S. Within a rung, endpoints are visited in the frozen seeded order, and for each endpoint the V2 fetch is executed first, then the V1 fetch (per-endpoint inter-vantage skew of seconds; disclosed). Actual per-request and per-rung timestamps are recorded; per-rung metrics use nominal rungs; delta_ref_actual is measured per vantage and must be >= 1500 s for both. Within-vantage same-endpoint spacing remains >= 300 s exactly as in the parent protocol.
measurement_validity.activity_disclosure: The only pre-freeze activity is non-outcome-bearing and DESIGN-local: (i) egress-substrate probes on neutral/oracle hosts only (NEVER the frozen 57 pool, whose V2-side classes are the scientific outcome): tor installation and bootstrap, HTTPTunnelPort CONNECT tunneling with the stdlib urllib client, oracle-host classification through both egresses (probe_tunnel.py sha256 ba96913d25c7343a28f39bd3eb6e2e020fb669289cab3c55f11cf9df56b6e3bc, output ae7586a75338a7b5c1ac689659d0766555195feae2d56f33aef9deaa1d89e90a), exit pinning via control port (pin_test.py sha256 59f62f4c1e89b0b6c67a1874fba3e03653b75a94721d47a71dbfd11c2c38558b, output 94db550abb39f768fa22dd192ad3cf4be7ae7e87ba114d8e7d036ba1788fc702), and egress-identity service availability through the tunnel (api.ipify.org, ifconfig.co/json, ipwho.is, cloudflare cdn-cgi/trace, check.torproject.org/api/ip usable; ipinfo.io and ip-api.com blocked by the tunnel - documented); (ii) offline estimator/PC/NC/negative-reachability calibration on synthetic worlds with the EXACT frozen branch rule (calibrate_cv.py sha256 7b35e2e0e0e78fb638269127b0053a5bfe06a52abadaec64472982e194ae14db, output fbaabfeac1f4e9c612f9b4e34b9190ad63e75d01f2f2fa000b627370bce5a6bc). These establish attainability, calibration and branch reachability only; EXECUTE re-verifies all floors and controls from its own data; the raw probe artifacts are DESIGN-local (/tmp) and are NOT interpretation dependencies.

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CHALLENGE_RE_LITERAL: (?i)(just a moment|cf-browser-verification|cf[-_]chl[-_]|challenge-platform|cf-challenge|cdn-cgi/challenge|attention required|checking your browser|enable javascript and cookies|verify you are human|please complete the security check|g-recaptcha|hcaptcha|recaptcha|cf-turnstile|<title>\s*just a moment)
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.match_scope: CHALLENGE_RE is applied to the first 262144 bytes of the response body decoded as utf-8 with errors ignored. cf-mitigated is lowercased and compared to the string 'challenge'.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CLEAN: HTTP status in 200..299 (2xx) AND body does not match CHALLENGE_RE.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE: HTTP status == 403 AND (lowercase(cf-mitigated) == 'challenge' OR body matches CHALLENGE_RE).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.UNAVAILABLE_403: HTTP status == 403 without any challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.TRANSPORT_ERROR: No HTTP response (DNS failure, connection refused, TLS failure, timeout, or tunnel failure).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.OTHER_NONBARRIER: Any other HTTP status (404, 500, redirect chains to error) OR a 2xx carrying a challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.label_determinism: All classes are functions of a single request's stored fields only; none depends on prior requests or on the vantage tag.

frozen_universe.source: verbatim endpoints of EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068, inherited unchanged by EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597 and reused VERBATIM here; NOT extended. EXECUTE may not substitute, add to, or drop endpoints.

sweep_protocol.unit: (endpoint, vantage, sweep_index); anchor = sweep 0 (T0) on each vantage
sweep_protocol.session_start: S = the instant the pre-flight (tor provision + exit pin verification + oracle battery + egress identity record) completes successfully; both vantages share S.
sweep_protocol.ambient_probe: For EVERY (endpoint, vantage): a fresh cookie jar, then exactly ONE HTTP GET; store raw fields; ambient_class = frozen classifier output. Endpoints are visited in a per-rung frozen seeded permutation order (seed 38121193195). For each endpoint the V2 fetch is executed FIRST through the pinned tunnel opener, THEN the V1 fetch through the direct opener. Inter-endpoint gap 0.30 s. The ambient ladder is the PRIMARY state for all metrics.
sweep_protocol.per_rung_pre_checks: Immediately before each rung sweep: (i) V2 exit IP via https://api.ipify.org through the tunnel - must equal the pinned pre-flight exit IP; (ii) V2 route-health oracle https://httpbin.org/status/200 through the tunnel - must classify CLEAN; (iii) V1 IP via direct https://api.ipify.org and V1 ASN via direct http://ip-api.com/json - ASN must equal the anchor V1 ASN. Any failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact egress series recorded.
sweep_protocol.anchor_egress_record: At the anchor only: V2 via https://ifconfig.co/json (IP/ASN/asn_org/country/hostname), https://ipwho.is/ (redundant), https://check.torproject.org/api/ip (IsTor must be true), https://api.ipify.org; V1 via http://ip-api.com/json and https://api.ipify.org. Distinctness gate: V2 IP != V1 IP AND V2 ASN != V1 ASN AND V2 country != V1 country.
sweep_protocol.request_headers: Frozen User-Agent 'SPIDER-research2/1.0 (+credential-free access-state persistence probe)' and Accept: */*; HTTP GET only; no authentication; no JavaScript.

request_policy.v1_opener: direct default route urllib opener (as the parent)
request_policy.v2_opener: same urllib client with ProxyHandler({'http','https'}: http://127.0.0.1:19051) routing through the pinned tor HTTPTunnelPort CONNECT proxy (byte-transparent TLS tunnel)
request_policy.note: No retry, so a DNS/connect/TLS/timeout/tunnel failure is directly TRANSPORT_ERROR. The per_host_requests=2 oracle controls are two independent observations, not retries.

sweep_protocol.partial_ladder_rule: Analysis labels each sweep by its NOMINAL rung; per-rung metrics use nominal rungs. Actual elapsed deltas are recorded and reported per vantage. If on EITHER vantage the anchor fails entirely, or the delta_ref sweep actual delta < 1500 s, or fewer than 3 T0 intrinsic / 3 T0 barrier endpoints are observed, or the egress/route gates fail at any rung, the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

stratum_intrinsic_candidates.definition: Fixed pre-registered towards-persistent candidates inherited from the parent's accepted V1 anchor evidence (result O9) and the parent census; reported as a diagnostic subgroup (the PARENT_V1_DENYLIST), NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

stratum_stress.definition: The parent's fixed pre-registered rate-limit-capable stratum, EXCLUDED from the 52-endpoint non-stress robustness subset but INCLUDED in the full-pool primary inference population. No induced-transience probe is run in this experiment (the parent answered Q3; the mandate varies the vantage axis, not the rate-transience axis).

strata.primary_inference_population: The full frozen 57-endpoint pool for all primary metrics on both vantages; CV_SKILL_NO_STRESS and per-vantage barrier-prevalence trends on the 52 non-stress endpoints are the pre-registered robustness replicas.

decision_rule.primary_metric: V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL for the within-vantage replication of the accepted S1 result at the second egress; CV_SKILL for the cross-vantage agreement (mandate Q3).
decision_rule.metric_definition: V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta) = plug-in mutual information I(B_V2_T0; B_V2_delta) in nats over the V2 binary barrier indicator, with B_EXCHANGE_V2 global endpoint-permutation p-value (10000 permutations) and endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI. CV_SKILL = plug-in I(B_V1_T0; B_V2_T0) in nats with B_CROSSVANTAGE global endpoint-permutation p-value (10000 permutations) and endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI. Higher = more information carried across time (V2) or across vantages (CV).

primary_decision_quantities.V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT: (n_t0_intrinsic_V2 >= 3) AND for every intrinsic class c in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} present at the V2 anchor: V2_CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c] at delta_ref >= 0.80.
primary_decision_quantities.V2_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID: V2_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(delta_ref) <= 0.20 AND V2_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(delta_ref) <= 0.20, both computed on the V2 intrinsic set only.
primary_decision_quantities.V2_STAT_SIG: V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) >= 0.05 AND B_EXCHANGE_V2 permutation p < 0.05 AND endpoint-clustered CI lower > 0.
primary_decision_quantities.CV_AGREEMENT_SIG: CV_SKILL(T0) >= 0.05 AND B_CROSSVANTAGE permutation p < 0.05 AND endpoint-clustered CI lower > 0.
primary_decision_quantities.CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID: CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20 AND CV_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20, building the denylist on the V1 anchor intrinsic set and testing at V2 delta_ref (denominators |V1 anchor intrinsic| and |V1 anchor non-intrinsic|).

secondary_quantities.V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS: V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) restricted to the 52 non-stress endpoints with its own permutation p.
secondary_quantities.CV_SKILL_NO_STRESS: CV_SKILL(T0) restricted to the 52 non-stress endpoints with its own permutation p.
secondary_quantities.CV_CLASS_AGREEMENT_T0 / CV_INTRINSIC_AGR: fraction of endpoints whose ambient class (or intrinsic indicator) is identical between V1 and V2 at the anchor.
secondary_quantities.V2_CLASS_PERSISTENCE / V2_INTRINSIC_PERS: as defined in the falsifier; within-V2 replica of the parent metrics.
secondary_quantities.V1_*: the same within-vantage metrics computed on the V1 arm (the reference egress), replicating the parent's accepted metrics on this session's V1 side: V1_STATIONARITY_SKILL, V1_CLASS_PERSISTENCE, V1_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENCE, V1_DENYLIST_*, V1_n_t0_intrinsic, V1_n_t0_barrier, V1_f_b_obs, V1_REPLICATION_PARENT_DENYLIST_OVERLAP (|V1 anchor intrinsic set intersect parent O9 set| / |parent O9 set|).
secondary_quantities.V2_DENYLIST_BY_RUNG / V2_DENYLIST_HORIZO: within-V2 denylist validity per rung and the largest contiguous valid prefix (censored at 1800 s).
secondary_quantities.V2_ANYBARRIER_FALSE_ACCEPT: fraction of V2 anchor barrier_set endpoints non-barrier at V2 delta_ref (the cost of a naive pooled denylist including rate-limits at V2).
secondary_quantities.V2_DENYLIST_SKILL: log-loss improvement (nats/endpoint) of the V2 anchor intrinsic-transfer predictor over B_CONSTANT_USABLE at V2 delta_ref (eps=1e-6 as in the parent, operational definition recorded).
secondary_quantities.CV_AGREEMENT_BY_RUNG: CV_SKILL computed per rung (V1_r vs V2_r).
secondary_quantities.PARENT_DENYLIST_*: secondary direct test of the ACCEPTED artifact: build the denylist on the parent's frozen V1 anchor intrinsic set (result O9, 7 endpoints), test at V2 delta_ref: PARENT_DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT, PARENT_DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT, PARENT_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID. PARENT_DENYLIST_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RAW = the parent raw ambient_collection.jsonl (bound artifact) recomputed through the frozen classifier at its T0 sweep reproduces exactly the 7-endpoint O9 set; a mismatch is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This conflates session-time with vantage and is a secondary diagnostic, never a gate.
secondary_quantities.EGRESS_*: V1/V2 identity series per rung (ip, ASN, country, hostname, IsTor) and the gates EGRESS_V2_CONSTANT, EGRESS_V1_ASN_CONSTANT, EGRESS_DISTINCT.
secondary_quantities.BARRIER_PREVALENCE_TREND_V1 / _V2: two-sided trend of ambient barrier prevalence across rungs per vantage on the 52 non-stress endpoints, with clustered CI.
secondary_quantities.CLASSIFIER_REPLAY_MISMATCHES: number of stored records whose class recomputed by the frozen classifier differs from the stored class (must be 0).
secondary_quantities.POWER_AT_RHO98 / POWER_AT_RHO92: reported detection power of the branch rule using the frozen calibration.

branch_precedence: 1. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if ANY measurement_validity prerequisite fails: network unreachable to universe or oracle hosts on either vantage; classifier not reproducible (CLASSIFIER_REPLAY_MISMATCHES > 0); PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power < 0.80; NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive > 0.05; an oracle misclassified on either vantage; fewer than 3 T0 ambient intrinsic or fewer than 3 T0 ambient barrier endpoints on EITHER vantage; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s on either vantage; tor provision/pin/verification failure; EGRESS_V2_CONSTANT false; EGRESS_DISTINCT false; EGRESS_V1_ASN_CONSTANT false; V2 route-health oracle not CLEAN at any rung; PARENT_DENYLIST_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RAW false.
2. T1_VANTAGE_ROBUST iff V2_INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND V2_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID AND V2_STAT_SIG AND CV_AGREEMENT_SIG AND CV_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID.

3. T0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC otherwise, with the positive change class(es) reported among {v2_intrinsic_break, v2_denylist_violation, v2_no_anchor_information, no_cross_vantage_information, cross_vantage_transfer_violation}.
MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved exclusively for prerequisite/control/substrate failure and MUST NOT be reported as T0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC.
decision_rule.measurement_invalid_conditions: Network unreachable on either vantage; classifier non-reproducible; PC power < 0.80; NC false-positive > 0.05; any oracle misclassified on either vantage; fewer than 3 T0 intrinsic or fewer than 3 T0 barrier endpoints on either vantage; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s on either vantage; tor subtype unavailable (apt install failure, bootstrap timeout, pin verification failure after 3 attempts), exit rotation (EGRESS_V2_CONSTANT false), egress non-distinctness (EGRESS_DISTINCT false), V1 ASN change, per-rung V2 route-health failure, or PARENT_DENYLIST_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RAW false. These are attainability/measurement/substrate failures, not scientific results; each records the exact error series as the operational blocker receipt required by the mandate.
decision_rule.claim_ceiling: At most C-WEB-DYNAMICS = HYPOTHESIS here. T1_VANTAGE_ROBUST bounds the source-vantage axis for this frozen pool, this window ladder and this datacenter <-> Tor egress pair (extending the accepted single-vantage S1_STATIONARY to a second independent egress); it does not by itself upgrade C-WEB-DYNAMICS and authorizes NO PRODUCT_CORE promotion and NO EXPERIMENTAL upgrade from this single egress-pair/window ladder. T0 bounds (does not reject) a shared static-denylist prior to per-egress scheduling on this pool/window and egress pair.

product_consequence_positive: If T1_VANTAGE_ROBUST: ONE shared intrinsic denylist (POLICY_SHARED_DENYLIST) is licensed across the two tested egress networks for this pool/window, so the dead-end policy can use a single class-conditional barrier schedule without per-egress class tables, and the V2 denylist horizon (V2_DENYLIST_HORIZON) quantifies the shared re-probe interval (right-censored at 1800 s). If PARENT_DENYLIST_TRANSFER_VALID additionally holds, the ACCEPTED single-vantage denylist artifact itself transfers to the independent vantage (secondary, time-conflated diagnostic). Construct boundary: adoption as a product prior still requires at least one non-Tor independent egress replication (Tor exits are purpose-built anonymity nodes with extreme WAF treatment).
product_consequence_negative: If T0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC: the intrinsic barrier access decision is vantage-specific on this pool/window within the tested datacenter <-> Tor egress pair; POLICY_PER_EGRESS_DENYLIST is required (per-egress or per-egress-type class tables and re-probe schedules), and a single shared intrinsic denylist is falsified as a universal prior for this pool. If EGRESS_DISTINCT is certified but deposition is a broad V2 over-block (many V1-clean endpoints intrinsic at V2), the negative is bounded to the Tor-egress type and does NOT rule out transfer across residential/datacenter egress pairs. Either way the finding is bounded to this frozen pool, this window ladder and this egress pair; C-WEB-DYNAMICS stays HYPOTHESIS.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Both two-sided branches are reachable through the exact frozen branch logic, verified by the DESIGN-local offline calibration on synthetic worlds (no Web outcomes). T1_VANTAGE_ROBUST selected by the EXACT five-part rule (including both permutation tests and both endpoint-clustered CI clauses) in 245/300 planted robust-transfer replications at rho=0.98 (0.8167 >= 0.80) and 219/300 at rho=0.92 (0.73, reported); the CV permutation test was significant in 300/300 PC replications. T0_VANTAGE_SPECIFIC selected in 300/300 exchangeable replications (CV p-sig 0.04 <= 0.05), in 300/300 vantage-superset replications (T0 via cross_vantage_transfer_violation, FR ~ 0.30 > 0.20 while CV agreement itself stayed significant 0.92, proving the transfer clause adds discrimination), and in 300/300 independent-but-stationary replications (T0 via no_cross_vantage_information, CV p-sig 0.02). Thresholds are arithmetically attainable: with n_t0_intrinsic_V2 >= 3 and per-class persistence, V2_STATIONARITY_SKILL >= H(3/57) ~ 0.206 > 0.05 and CV_SKILL ~ I(marginals with high overlap) >= 0.05; FA tolerance is 1/7, FR tolerance 10/50, so both a strict-superset negative and a robust positive sit inside the decision space. Precedence has no trap: the five T0 change classes are each independently producible (calibration rows above) and MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved for prerequisite/control/substrate failure, exactly as the mandate requires for the blocker receipt.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Prerequisites are stdlib Python 3.12 ONLY (numpy not required) plus a provisionable second egress and live network to the frozen universe and oracle hosts on both egresses. Pre-freeze probes: `sudo apt-get install -y tor` installed tor 0.4.9.11 on this runner; a dedicated tor instance with SocksPort 0 / HTTPTunnelPort 127.0.0.1:19051 bootstrapped 100% in ~7 s; the frozen stdlib urllib client with ProxyHandler through the CONNECT tunnel returned identical oracle classes on both egresses (httpbin 200/uuid, example.com -> CLEAN; httpbin 429, httpbingo 429 -> RATE_LIMIT_429; httpbin 403 -> UNAVAILABLE_403; no-such-host.invalid -> TRANSPORT_ERROR); control-port pinning (SETCONF ExitNodes=<ip> StrictNodes=1; NEWNYM) held the exit constant 5/5 checks; egress identity services (ipify, ifconfig.co, ipwho.is, cf-trace, check.torproject.org) all reachable through the tunnel; V1 direct egress alive and stable (AS8075). The >= 3 V2 anchor intrinsic/barrier floors are not measurable pre-freeze (probing the frozen pool from V2 would BE the outcome); they rest on a disclosed general prior that WAFs challenge anonymized exits broadly and are verified at the EXECUTE anchor; a shortfall is the mandate's blocker receipt (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), not a scientific negative. EXECUTE re-verifies all floors, controls and gates from its own data.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Both nulls are non-degenerate and the metrics separate the regimes rather than sitting at a ceiling. Pre-freeze calibration on the exact statistic family: NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE gave CV p-sig fraction 0.04 (<= 0.05) with mean CV_SKILL 0.0106 nats and T1 0/300, while PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY gave mean CV_SKILL 0.3312 nats at rho=0.98 (T1 0.8167, CV p-sig 1.0) and 0.3316 at rho=0.92; the within-V2 statistic replicates the parent's accepted separation (parent NC 0.0102 vs PC 0.3261 nats). With equal marginals the maximum attainable CV_SKILL is H(f_b) ~ 0.41 nats at f_b ~ 0.14 >> the 0.05 threshold, and under the exchangeable null the mean (0.0106) sits far below it, so no ceiling/floor collapse is possible. B_CONSTANT_USABLE is distinct from the anchor-transfer predictor because the pool mixes clean and barrier endpoints (f_b_obs > 0), so MI is defined. The identifiers here are estimator-vs-strong-null pairs (within-V2 and cross-vantage), and the PC/NC pair brackets the admitted range exactly as in the accepted parent packet.

control_sensitivity.reason: Two disjoint synthetic controls bracket the pipeline with demonstrated, not asserted, sensitivity on the exact planned statistic and branch: PC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY fires T1 in 245/300 (CV permutation-significant 300/300) while NC_CROSS_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE stays T1 0/300 with CV p-sig 0.04. Two live controls validate the real collection+classifier path on BOTH planned egresses pre-freeze: PC_ORACLE_BARRIER classified httpbin 429 and httpbingo 429 as RATE_LIMIT_429 and no-such-host.invalid as TRANSPORT_ERROR both direct and through the tunnel; NC_CLEAN_ORACLE classified httpbin 200/uuid and example.com as CLEAN on both; httpbin 403 classified UNAVAILABLE_403 on both. C_VANTAGE_EVIDENCE adds the egress-distinctness/constancy/route-health gates with demonstrated failing modes (unpinned exit rotation observed in ~2 min; /24 pinning rotates within the subnet; ip-literal pinning holds) and C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION adds per-vantage protocol self-induction trends. EXECUTE re-runs all of these; any failure is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
